settings.title: Commitment
settings.description: Score for each member as part of the group: attendance, notice, punctuality, jersey, payment and participation. Independent of playing level.
settings.enabledHint: Computed from what happens in each match. While off, it is neither shown nor used.
settings.windowMatchesHint: Only the group's last N finished matches
settings.lateCancelHoursHint: Cancelling with less notice than this counts as a late cancel
settings.minMatchesHint: Below this the member shows as new, without a score
settings.visibilityGroupHint: Shown on the players list to everyone
settings.priorityOffHint: First come, first served, as usual
settings.priorityWindowHint: When signup opens, members above the threshold take spots; everyone else waits and is promoted automatically when the window closes.
settings.priorityWaitlistHint: When someone drops out, the highest-scored member is promoted instead of the first in line
settings.priorityReservedHint: Spots are held for higher-scored members until a few hours before kickoff
settings.noShowCooldownHint: After a no-show, the next signup goes to the waitlist even if there is room
settings.captainsCanReportHint: Arrived late, wrong jersey and unpaid on a finished match
settings.eventWeightsHint: Stored with each event; they only drive manual adjustments and the points breakdown.
settings.dimensionWeightsHint: How much each sub-score weighs in the total. They must add up to 1.
settings.dimensionSumError: Dimension weights must add up to 1.00 (they add up to {sum})
settings.invalidNumbers: Check the numbers: they must be valid and greater than zero

signupPolicy.cooldownTitle: This time you go to the waitlist

waitlistReason.priority_window: You're on the waitlist because of the priority window. Once it ends you get promoted automatically if there is room.
waitlistReason.reserved: You're on the waitlist because the last spots are reserved. You get promoted automatically if there is room.
waitlistReason.cooldown: You're on the waitlist because you missed the last match. You get promoted automatically if a spot opens up.
waitlistReason.full: You're on the waitlist because the match is full. We'll let you know if a spot opens up.
